assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack.
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture real-time electrocardiographic data during symptom onset.
The service is necessary to correlate these episodic symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances.
